config.description: v028's exact recipe and architecture with ONE change: loss.distill_weight 1.0 -> 2.0. 225,922 params, hidden 128, same teacher, same schedule, same seed. Second and third points on the distillation-weight curve.
config.hypothesis: distill_weight is the steepest lever found so far and it has only two samples. 0.5 to 1.0 alone gave +0.001829 (+11.5 sigma) on full validation, which transferred to public as +0.0017 against +0.0018 predicted. Two points cannot distinguish a curve still climbing from one that has already turned over, and the practical consequences differ completely: still climbing means push past 2.0; turned over means 1.0 was the optimum and the remaining headroom is elsewhere. Prediction: NOT yet turned over, because the teacher is itself only 0.690168 local while the student sits at 0.686510, so teacher signal remains to absorb. Counter-consideration, recorded so the result reads either way: dozken reports his best distilled model peaking at epoch 3 and DECLINING after, so over-regularising toward the teacher is a real failure mode, not hypothetical. If 2.0 lands below v028 by more than 0.000317 the optimum is at or below 1.0 and this axis is closed.
config.change_vs_parent: loss.distill_weight 1.0 -> 2.0 only. gamma stays absent (0), so the teacher term is weighted exactly as in v028; this isolates the weight and nothing else.
